Taking the body of literature on the topic into account, interference appears to be best minimized by either inserting a lengthy intervening recovery period between aerobic and resistance bouts or, perhaps even better, performing them on separate days. Indeed, Wilson and colleagues (79) found a trend for greater hypertrophy when aerobic and resistance exercise were performed on separate days as opposed to in the same session (effect size of 1.05 vs. 0.8, respectively).
